rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also submit a copy of that notice and tenant contact information to the City through an online verification form.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources must accompany notice to quit/non-renewal; fine up to $300 per day
rules.citation: City of Boston Ordinances Sec. 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
rules.coverage_text: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.
rules.penalty: Enforced by Inspectional Services Department: warning for 1st offense; $300 per day for 2nd and subsequent offenses. Failure to submit the notice to the City may result in a fine up to $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.extraction_note: This is an eviction-notice disclosure requirement, not a just-cause (permitted causes) rule; it is classified under just_cause_eviction only for its notice component. The page does not state an effective or enactment date, so status is inferred as in force from the City's description of a current requirement. The violation-reporting section calls it the 'new' Act.
